Res.Caption: Estimate Defaulted From
Res.FullDescription: Specifies a date that the estimate of this milestone is defaulted from.\r\nThe date can be defaulted from the estimate or actual date of a predecessor milestone or, for some Workflow types, a system defined event that occurs.\r\nThe estimate date on this milestone will be defaulted from the other related date when it becomes available, and the job is saved.

Res.Caption: Estimate Default Hours
Res.FullDescription: The number of hours difference to apply when defaulting the estimate date of this Milestone from another date.

Res.Caption: Assigned Group
Res.FullDescription: The assigned or responsible staff group. When 'Reminder' is ticked, the calendar item is placed in the calendar of each member of the staff group.

Res.Caption: Required Capability
Res.FullDescription: The Capability which an assigned resource must possess.

Res.Caption: Task Assigned To
Res.FullDescription: The assigned or responsible staff member. When 'Reminder' is ticked, the calendar item is placed in the staff member's calendar.

Res.Caption: Reminder
Res.FullDescription: If ticked, an appointment item will be created in the assigned staff's calendar.

Res.Caption: Recalculate Estimated
Res.FullDescription: If ticked, the scheduled date on the milestones will be recalculated each time the job is saved and the actual date is empty.

Res.Caption: Import Country/Region
Res.FullDescription: The country/region of export the job must belong to.

Res.FullDescription: The task will be closed when the milestones with a matching key are completed.

Res.Caption: Exception Event
Res.FullDescription: The event that is raised against the job when the milestone is not met.

Res.Caption: Task Completion Event
Res.FullDescription: The event which is added to the task's parent job when the task is closed.

Res.Caption: Interruptible
Res.FullDescription: Specifies whether this task is low switch-cost start-able, meaning that it can be interrupted by a critical handover task with little cost.

Res.Caption: Workflow
Res.FullDescription: Specifies the workflow that this task belongs to. A workflow defines a group of tasks that can be worked and released for work separate to other tasks.
